test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Riya asked, “Are you feeling fine?”

options.text: Riya told me if I was feeling fine.
Riya asked me if I was feeling fine.
Riya asked me if I was feeling fine?
Riya asked her if she was feeling fine.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In indirect speech, we report what someone else has said without quoting their exact words. 
 
• When converting a direct question into indirect speech, we generally use the reporting verb "ask" and adjust the pronouns and verb forms accordingly.
 
• In the given sentence, "Riya asked, 'Are you feeling fine?'" the reporting verb is "asked," so we use "asked" in the indirect speech. 
 
• The pronouns also change from "you" to "me" because Riya is asking someone else (not the person speaking).
 
• The verb "are" changes to "was" to match the tense of the reporting verb.

Therefore, the correct indirect speech version is: "***Riya asked me if I was feeling fine***."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 is inappropriate.
 
• Option 3 is inappropriate.
 
• Option 4 is inappropriate.
